about.title: About
about.what: {site} plays PS1 games in your browser. Nothing to install: open the page, add a game, use the keyboard or a controller.
about.rule1: Only games that may legally be shared are hosted here: homebrew, freeware and demos with explicit permission. No commercial games and no BIOS files, ever.
about.rule2: Games you add yourself stay in your browser. They are never uploaded and we never see their names.
about.rule3: You can optionally add a BIOS file you own. It is stored in your browser like a game and never leaves it.
about.rule4: This site is not affiliated with or endorsed by Sony. "PS1" is used only to describe compatibility.
